scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.lint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js . && npm run typecheck && node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check .
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
